decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ +0.7% and S&P 500 +0.3% — not the strong risk-on signal (NASDAQ +2%+) our strategy requires for new high-conviction buys. Cash on hand ($189.29) is also below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding all 7 positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the NASDAQ up 0.7%, reflecting a lack of strong directional conviction from investors. Without a major catalyst, trading stayed range-bound as market participants awaited clearer signals on economic data and corporate earnings. This kind of low-volatility, mixed-signal session is typical of consolidation phases after recent moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢溫和向上，標普500指數升0.3%，納斯達克指數升0.7%，反映投資者缺乏明確方向。市場在沒有重大催化劑的情況下窄幅波動，投資者仍在等待更清晰的經濟數據及企業盈利訊號。這種低波動、訊號混雜的交投情況，通常屬於近期升勢後的整固階段。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to invest when a strong opportunity appears. Today, with the market only mildly positive and cash below our deployment threshold, holding that cash reserve rather than forcing a trade keeps us ready to act decisively when a clearer risk-on signal shows up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留在場邊、待有明確機會時才動用的現金。今日大市只屬溫和造好，加上現金未達動用門檻，保留現金儲備而非勉強出手，可讓我們在真正出現風險偏好上升訊號時果斷加碼。
